# Indobase

> Indobase is an open-source backend platform for building web and mobile applications, built for
> Indian developers and SMBs. It provides authentication, a Postgres database, storage, edge
> functions, and realtime — plus an AI app builder that turns a prompt into a working app wired to
> that backend. Pricing is in INR and DPDP-aware; data is hosted in India.

Indobase is a Supabase-compatible backend: apps use the `@indobaseinc/indobase-js` client with the
same REST, Auth, Storage, and Realtime semantics. The AI builder (Indobase Builder) generates the
frontend and, when an app needs persistence or auth, wires it to a linked Indobase project.

## Core capabilities

- **Auth**: email/password and provider sign-in, JWT-based, row-level-security aware.
- **Database**: dedicated Postgres per project, accessed over PostgREST.
- **Storage**: S3-compatible object storage with image transforms.
- **Edge Functions**: Deno-based serverless functions.
- **Realtime**: subscribe to database changes over WebSockets.
- **Builder**: prompt-to-app generation, schema-aware, one-click publish.

## Plans

- **Free (₹0)**: 1 app, *.indobase.app subdomain, 500 MB database, sleeps after 7 days idle. Builder only (no Studio dashboard).
- **Basic (₹499/mo)**: Studio unlocked, custom domain, 3 apps, 1 GB database.
- **Pro (₹1,999/mo)**: 5 apps, 8 GB database, isolated stack, GitHub export, 7-day backups.
- **Studio (₹6,999/mo)**: 15 apps, 3 seats, shared billing, 14-day backups, priority support.
- **Enterprise**: DPDP audit pack, SLA, dedicated placement, SSO. Contact sales.
